title: The item tool plan: yes, or changes?

owner_note.text: The plan is one item tool with three verbs, get, set and call, which replaces the five page tools and about 40 Servex tools. page_tools.js goes from 1,881 lines to about 250, in eight small merges at about $45, and the log format does not change. Say yes, or tell me what to change, and the first merge starts. That merge only adds the verbs, so nothing breaks.
